annotations.title: The Line: practice against the house

description: A practice match against one of The Line's house bots, with the real rules and the bots' real code, run here: no wallet, coin or registration, nothing recorded, no clock. Start with no `practice`; then call again with the `practice` id it returned and every pull you've made so far, the newest last (it replays them). When the match ends, `replay_url` is a page on highwire.fun that replays it, to watch or share. Practice proves nothing: the house's moves come from the seed in the id. To play for a record, see highwire.fun/line.md.

opponent.description: "reader" (reads your habits) or "even" (the exact equilibrium). Only when starting.

practice.description: The id from the first call. Omit to start a new match.

pulls.description: All your pulls so far, in order, the newest last.
